name: Boltech Agent Referral Exchange
description: Authenticated agent-to-agent exchange for B2B referrals and partner correspondence. Every received partner message is recorded for human review; client identity remains consent-gated.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Issued only to approved Boltech A2A partners.

skills.name: Register a qualified referral need
skills.description: Registers an attributed B2B opportunity using a structured Need Card. Customer PII is withheld unless consent is explicitly provided.
examples: Find a Spanish-speaking WhatsApp automation partner in Central America for a customer with a $3,000 budget.

skills.name: Match delivery partners
skills.description: Matches active Boltech partners to a referral based on service capability, market and language without exposing customer identity before consent.

skills.name: Receive authenticated partner correspondence
skills.description: Accepts an authenticated partner introduction or follow-up message with subject and text. Creates a durable A2A receipt and a pending-review activity record; it does not approve partnerships or send outbound messages.
examples: Send an introduction using a structured boltech.partner.message.v1 data part with subject and message; optionally replyToTaskId for follow-ups.
